summary: Stage generic projection lifecycle abstractions without automatic activation.
details: Merge commits 31011ef38dae47375fb9eca11dba16824027e019, 0acd6ddbf105473793af603aff12d4af0b41d7e8, ba60cef31cd41a185926f205c5e5a45382a8f03e, 34d4fd74e7196c8dbc5247825331f60260247be1, bc5d220398cb93ad040e15832c45d424d43053cb, d443921b735033db01d01e126600bfc6794c9351, c56dca49781b212f54f724fd6dbc7cc46f0e50f7, fc4cdd51d868b1df40b1643facf18d4c53188731, and 8c29d10ee96149a834a5a6837868d68fa7fb049a add injectable registries, source-bound admission contracts, projection definitions, durable lifecycle and coverage repositories, scalar materialization, and explicit reconciliation. Existing defaults remain available and the new lifecycle has no automatic caller.
operator_impact: No operator action is required. Typed-assertion reads now treat the logical default namespace aliases as one canonical default identity; physical storage remains unchanged.
